{{Quote|Corellian Engineering Corporation knows that customer satisfaction goes far beyond whether the pilot's seat is comfortable and the controls are in reach. CEC also knows that no two customers are the same. While other starship manufacturers typically limit crew-facilities options to humanoid customers, CEC builds ships for ''all'' spacefarers.|''CEC YT-1300 Buyers' Guide''|<ref name="Millennium Falcon Owner's Workshop Manual">''[[Millennium Falcon Owner's Workshop Manual]]''</ref>}}
The '''''CEC YT-1300 Buyers' Guide''''' was a guide that was published by the [[Corellian Engineering Corporation/Legends|Corellian Engineering Corporation]], to promote sales of the [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300 light freighter]].
